source.description:
PROBLEM: Running npm run gen-registry on released v0.10.5 rewrites hundreds of .xtrm/registry.json entries from version 0.10.4 to 0.10.5. This means the committed registry was not regenerated with the released package version and creates unrelated drift during maintenance tasks.
SCOPE: .xtrm/registry.json, scripts/gen-registry.mjs, and release/version sequencing; needs comparison against current in-flight main changes.
